title: Annanukku Jey
desc: A toddy seller's son becomes a politician and overcomes multiple challenges in order to take revenge from the bar owner, who mistreated his father.

title: Vaanam Kottattum
desc: After committing a revenge killing, a man serves time in prison, but the repercussions of his crime continue to haunt his family long after.

title: Geetha Govindam
desc: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

title: Naveena Thenali
desc: Tenali Ramakrishna, a lawyer who loses cases for profit, fights for justice in one such case.

title: Meiyazhagan
desc: Arul visits his hometown for a wedding. He meets a relative whose kindness helps him reconnect with forgotten family ties and precious memories.

desc: Bullet Raja is killed by Babu, a goon, because both love the same girl. Bullet fights with the god of death and is sent back into the body of Ravindra, a minister who was killed by his own associates.

title: Veppam
desc: Karthik's life changes when his father exploits his friend for a drug-peddling assignment.

title: Bhai
desc: A ruthless crime lord's plan to eliminate a police officer backfires when the henchman assigned to kill him discovers the target is his long-lost brother.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Avane Srimannarayana
desc: Narayana attempts to solve the mystery behind the treasure that has gone missing. However, Jayaram, a gang leader, places several obstacles in his way.

title: Marina
desc: Ambikathy, an orphan, leaves his cruel uncle and ends up at Marina Beach, where he sells food to save money for night school, determined to pursue his dream of getting an education.

title: Katamarayudu

title: Kondraal Paavam
desc: The life of a poverty-stricken family becomes more complicated after an unanticipated visitor who goes by the name Arjunan, enters their household.

title: Nandhi Varman
desc: Paranormal activities begin to happen when a crew starts excavating a temple that is believed to be concealed beneath the earth.

title: Goli Soda 2
desc: A taxi driver, a gangster and an athlete want to create a space for themselves. However, when fate strikes, they end up losing everything and their struggle towards reclaiming their lives begins.

title: Thrissur Pooram
